_readme: Custom tools for the KYC Refresh voice agent. Each `url` is one of this project's Supabase edge functions — replace {{FUNCTION_BASE_URL}} with https://<your-project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1 (or wherever you deploy them) when you register these as custom tools/functions on your agent. The fields here (type/name/url/parameters/speak_during_execution) follow a common custom-function tool shape — if your platform nests the JSON schema differently (e.g. under a `function` object), move `parameters` there; the schema itself doesn't change. `kyc_refresh_id` is handed to the agent as a dynamic variable at call start (see voice-agent-system-prompt.md) — pass it through on every tool call. Every one of these endpoints requires a static header `X-Tool-Secret: <your AGENT_TOOL_SECRET>` — set it as a custom header on each tool's config alongside its URL.

tools.name: verify_account
tools.description: Verifies the customer's identity against the last 4 digits of their account number and date of birth. Call this once per attempt during the 2FA step. Allows up to 3 attempts per call; after that the call must end.

kyc_refresh_id.description: The kyc_refresh_id dynamic variable for this call

digit_number.description: Last 4 digits of the account number, as spoken by the customer

dob.description: Date of birth the customer gave, normalized to YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_next_crs_country
tools.description: Given the full list of foreign tax residencies the customer just declared, returns the next country to collect a TIN for (skipping ones already recorded this call) and whether TIN collection is finished.

tax_residencies.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes the customer declared, UAE included or not

tools.name: store_tin_value
tools.description: Saves a Tax Identification Number the customer provided for a specific country.

tools.name: store_tin_reason
tools.description: Records why a customer cannot provide a TIN for a country, using the OECD exception reason codes: A = the country does not issue TINs, B = the customer is unable to obtain one, C = not required under that country's domestic law.

reason_explanation.description: Brief note on why, in the customer's own words

tools.name: submit_kyc_screening
tools.description: Submits the fully collected screening answers for final classification once the customer has confirmed their declaration is true and complete. Returns whether the refresh auto-completed or was escalated to the compliance team — use the response to choose your closing line.

tax_residencies.description: All declared tax residencies, ISO-2 codes, including AE if applicable

has_us_indicia.description: US citizen, green card holder, or born in the US

ssn.description: Only ask for and pass this if has_us_indicia is true

activity_status.description: Only set when the customer confirms the account is dormant

profile_updates.description: Only include fields the customer actually corrected

tools.name: end_call_early
tools.description: Closes out the refresh cycle for a call that is ending before reaching submit_kyc_screening: the customer declined to give consent at the start, declined to make the required declaration, or declined to proceed for some other reason. Call this immediately before hanging up.
